`rk.quantity`, `rk.money` and `rk.duration` take keyword-only arguments (D14): `UnitSystem(currencies=, definitions=)`, `UnitSystem.convert(quantity=, to=)`, `UnitSystem.register(name=, ...)`, `UnitSystem.alias(alias=, unit=)`, `rk.money.round(amount=, currency=, ...)`, `rk.duration.offset(value=, frequency=, ...)` and `rk.duration.cover(periods=, name=)`. Name the arguments that you passed by position. The natural pairs `compatible(left, right)`, `multiply(left, right)`, `divide(numerator, denominator)`, `count_steps(start, end, ...)` and `year_fraction(start, end, ...)` stay positional.
